id.description: Gets the unique ID for this carrier contact.

carrierId.description: Gets the unique ID for this carrier.

firstName.description: Gets the first name of the carrier contact.

lastName.description: Gets the last name of the carrier contact.

department.description: Gets the department this carrier contact is a part of.

jobDesc.description: Gets the job description for this carrier contact.

phone.description: Gets the phone number for this carrier contact.

phone2.description: Gets the phone number for this carrier contact.

phoneExtension.description: Gets the phone extension for this carrier contact.

phoneExtension2.description: Gets the phone extension for this carrier contact.

fax.description: Gets the fax number for this carrier contact.

email.description: Gets the e-mail address for this carrier contact.

defaultContact.description: Gets a value that indicates if the contact is the default contact.

address.description: Gets the street address for this carrier contact.

address2.description: Gets the second address line for this carrier contact.

city.description: Gets the city for this carrier contact location.

state.description: Gets the two-letter abbreviation for U.S. state/territory, Canadian, Carribbean or Mexican province.

zip.description: Gets the ZIP for this carrier contact location.

isDeleted.description: Gets a value indicating whether this carrier contact has been deleted.

roleId.description: Gets the unique role ID for this carrier contact.

lastUpdateDate.description: Gets the date on which this carrier contact was last updated.
